description: Owner-side admission grant for request/inviteOnly groups. Lives in a group admin/owner's repo. The corroborating record a member's com.authorityone.group.membership is validated against by the AppView. Revoke == delete this record.

group.description: Strong reference to the com.authorityone.group.profile this invite grants access to.

invitee.description: DID of the account being granted membership.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry; after this the invite is no longer corroborating.
